cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY' >/tmp/arb.json
import json,sys,struct
sys.path.insert(0,'project')
from wire import packet,payload,seal
f=bytearray(packet(0,0,payload(0,0,0,1)))
f[15]=0x12
f[18:20]=struct.pack('!H',0xbeef)
f[22]=7
f=seal(f)
c={'primitive':'allreduce','mode':3,'root':0,'segments':1,'words':1,'capacity':1,'start':0,'events':[{'op':'wire','rank':0,'hex':f.hex()}],'trace':2}
print(json.dumps({'cases':[c]}))
PY
python3 project/solver.py </tmp/arb.json >/tmp/arb.out; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
x=json.load(open('/tmp/arb.out'))['cases'][0]
print(x['state']);print([t['rank'] for t in x['trace']])
